base_model.principle: replace synthetic incident arrival times and locations with observed EGIF demand while holding the remaining v1.6 model assumptions fixed

cohort.year_selection_reason: first contiguous year through the archive end for which the v1.7 audit reports coordinates for every EGIF part in every year
cohort.midnight_policy: exclude from the primary replay any detection flagged midnight_precision_unknown; retain the exclusion and source timestamp in the cohort audit
cohort.calendar_grouping: group by the source detection calendar date without UTC or daylight-saving conversion
cohort.event_order: detected_at ascending, then incident_id lexical tie-break

historical_days.arrival_minute: hour*60 + minute + second/60 from observed detected_at

frozen_inputs.fleet: inherit v1.5 exactly: three modeled fire brigades F-01/F-02/F-03 at B2/B3/B4
frozen_inputs.potential_nodes: inherit the ten routing-eligible v1.4/v1.5 demand nodes

routing_extension.status: must be frozen before any policy outcomes are generated
routing_extension.profile: OSRM driving over OpenStreetMap, matching v1.0
routing_extension.semantics: current frozen road access to historical incident coordinates; not a reconstruction of the historical road network
required_directed_edges: every primary replay event -> each of the ten frozen potential nodes
all directed event-to-event pairs within the same historical calendar day
routing_extension.missing_route_policy: no imputation; retain incident/day exclusion with explicit reason
routing_extension.snap_distance_policy: record OSRM input-to-snapped-road distance as a diagnostic; do not exclude a wildfire solely because it is off-road

severity.assignment: deterministic per incident_id from the fixed v1.7.1 severity seed; identical across policies, hazard contexts and service times

service_rule: inherit the fixed v1.6 half / baseline / double sensitivity; no empirical service-time calibration in v1.7.1
harm_rule: inherit v1.6 evaluation only; K never changes dispatch decisions

hazard_context.mode: cross the same three frozen v1.4 AEMET snapshots with every historical day
hazard_context.purpose: hold the policy context fixed while replacing only the demand process

aggregation.paired_reference: lambda=0 under the identical historical day, hazard context and service time

claim_scope: exploratory replay of observed Málaga EGIF spatiotemporal demand using the frozen EcoDispatch v1.6 modeled fleet, severity, service-time sensitivity, policy family and non-historical hazard contexts
